method: byte-pattern scan + manual disassembly of every INT 10h site in every binary (wroot.exe + 10 overlays + 4 drivers)
summary: Exactly 2 EGA-palette-write sites total, both in wroot.exe at file offsets 0x209B and 0x2105. Zero AX=1000h (set-one-register), zero AX=1001h (set-overscan), zero AX=1003h (blink toggle). Zero direct EGA Attribute Controller port writes (no `MOV DX, 0x3C0`, no `MOV DX, 0x3DA`, no short-form `OUT 0xC0, AL`) across any binary. The engine has exactly two EGA palettes: wiz6-main (loaded at 0x209B) and wiz6-dungeon (loaded at 0x2105). The empirically-extracted `wiz6-title` palette in packages/viewer/src/palettes/wiz6-title.ts is therefore NOT a third engine palette — it must be either the BIOS-default EGA palette accessed through a permuted index mapping in the .ega screen decoder, or one of the two known palettes with a similar decoder-side permutation. See unresolved item below.

findings.claim: INT 10h AX=1002h site at wroot.exe 0x209B loads the wiz6-main palette table from CS:0x1E43 (file 0x2043)

evidence.caller_context: verified in docs/re/palette-discovery.md; loaded once at startup; presumed to be the default for the main game UI and character creation

findings.claim: INT 10h AX=1002h site at wroot.exe 0x2105 loads the wiz6-dungeon palette table from CS:0x1E54 (file 0x2054)

evidence.caller_context: verified in docs/re/palette-discovery.md; presumed to be the dungeon palette (blue-leaning); indices 9-15 identical to wiz6-main

findings.claim: No INT 10h AX=1000h (set one palette register), AX=1001h (set overscan), or AX=1003h (blink toggle) sites exist in any binary
No direct EGA Attribute Controller port writes exist in any binary

byte_patterns_searched: BA C0 03 (MOV DX, 0x3C0 — AC index port)
BA DA 03 (MOV DX, 0x3DA — Input Status / AC reset preamble)

findings.claim: All other INT 10h sites in wroot.exe are not palette manipulations

sites_decoded.function: AH=00h (set video mode); mode loaded from cs:0x1B4C
AH=02h (set cursor position); cursor to (0,0) on page 0
AH=0Bh, BX=0101h (CGA palette select; CGA-only function, does not touch EGA palette registers)

unresolved: The empirical wiz6-title palette in packages/viewer/src/palettes/wiz6-title.ts is NOT loaded by any engine code site identified in this scan. Its 16 RGB tuples are exactly the standard EGA_DEFAULT palette values, but assigned to permuted file-bit-pattern indices (e.g. file pattern 0x1 maps to EGA-15 white, file pattern 0x2 maps to EGA-9 light blue). Most likely interpretation: the title-sequence .ega files are rendered before the engine programs the first palette (so EGA hardware is at BIOS default), and our .ega screen decoder needs an explicit index permutation step instead of carrying it implicitly via this calibration palette. Action: during Phase 2 catalog construction, do NOT promote wiz6-title to the catalog as a new palette. Instead, retain it temporarily under a clear comment marking it as a decoder-bit-permutation artifact pending fix; alternatively, fix the .ega decoder to permute indices to EGA_DEFAULT and ship the catalog with just ega-default + wiz6-main + wiz6-dungeon. Decision deferred to implementation.
